prompts.prompt: In MongoDB, what is the minimum default size of the WiredTiger internal cache, regardless of how little RAM the host machine has? Answer with the exact number and unit.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/mongodb/SKILL.md - WiredTiger Storage Engine section states default cache size is 50 percent of RAM minus 1GB, with a minimum of 256MB.
